(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) is a global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services. They are seeking a Junior Software Developer to design and develop high-performance applications using modern software technologies, focusing on microservices architecture.
Junior Java backend engineer developing mission-critical microservices for government data-processing systems

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop and support Java backend software in support of mission objectives
• Provide ongoing development, maintenance, support, and software enhancements in existing systems and platforms
• Troubleshoot complex problems and provide customer support for software systems and application issues
• Provide recommendations for continuous improvement
• Work alongside other engineers on the team to sustain and advance our organization’s capabilities

Requirements:
• Active TS/SCI with Polygraph
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline
• 0+ years of application design and development experience
• US Citizenship Required
• Skills: Agile Methodology, Software Development, Software Technologies
